Key responsibilities include:

  • Collaborating with stakeholders to define the security and controls strategy and guiding and monitoring its implementation
  • Performing resource planning and estimation for the design, implementation and testing of security and controls
  • Identifying risks in target state business processes and designing efficient and effective internal controls
  • Creating risk and control matrices for business process and IT general controls with risk descriptions and control design details and supporting clients in determining critical controls, control frequency and control owners
  • Conducting segregation of duties (SOD) and sensitive access (SA) analysis and documenting the security functional design
  • Over seeing the configuration, development and testing of roles and controls
  • Evaluating new and changing risks and accordingly identifying or updating existing audit and regulatory compliance requirements
